programme.desc: Astronauts Leah and Zac are on a quest to speak to an alien through their walkie talkies. When Leah wishes to be able to talk to one, Shimmer and Shine poof an alien into her backyard, where she can talk to one face to face!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Leah invites her genies over to join the fun. Leah makes a wish to make Zac's house look haunted, but the genies turn it into a real haunted house, with a real Frankenstein! It's a spooktacular adventure!

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Leah has invited Shimmer and Shine over for a sleepover party, where they'll eat pizza, dance all night, and sleep in a pillow fort! But when all the party plans go awry, the genies help Leah out with some wish granting.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Diane and Carla console Loretta, who has caught Nick cheating on her.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla falls head over heals for hockey star Eddie LeBec, a newly acquired goalie for the Bruins.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla realizes she's the reason Eddie's hockey game is suffering.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Diane and Sam agree to a twenty-four hour separation to purge other desires.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff files a lawsuit and ends up getting blindsided by the beautiful defendant.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: The regulars meet over dinner to discuss Frasier asking Lilith to move in.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Diane and Sam are given a bleak prognosis from a noted marriage counselor.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam flips out when his goddaughter visits and agrees to move in with Woody.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Norm lies about the prestige of his new position at a CPA firm.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody's parents want him to move back home, but the regulars try to keep him.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Diane buy a house from a couple who have been there for forty years.
programme.sub-title: A House Is Not A Home

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: With Sam and Diane's wedding day approaching, big questions still loom.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam returns to Cheers after sailing around the world and wants his job back.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam accepts an offer from his friend, sportscaster Dave Richards.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody finds a new admirer when he portrays Mark Twain as an understudy.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam buys a last minute Christmas gift for Rebecca from another shopper.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam and Woody take the rap for Rebecca when she breaks a priceless vase.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Carla gives birth to twins, a boy and girl. During Carla's absence, the bar hires two waitresses.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Mr. Drake invites Sam and Rebecca for a weekend on his yacht. Rebecca still pines for Mr. Drake.

programme.title: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
programme.desc: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

programme.title: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
programme.desc: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

programme.title: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
programme.desc: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
programme.desc: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.
programme.sub-title: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey

programme.title: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
programme.desc: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
programme.sub-title: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: La Petite Fée des Dents
programme.desc: Cartman se réveille et découvre que la fée des dents lui a apporté 2 dollars pour sa dent de lait. Il décide alors de chercher plein de dents pour s'acheter une console.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuple contorsionniste
programme.desc: Le cirque vient d'arriver à South Park. Le numéro des Quintuplés contorsionnistes donne envie aux enfants de faire un numéro.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Lors de l'interro de début de cours, Timmy, un nouvel élève handicapé ne sait pas répondre. Il est alors envoyé chez la principale. Les médecins lui diagnostiquent un déficit aigu de l'attention, qui le prive de devoirs.

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Cet épisode spécial est consacré à Pip, personnage très spécial inspiré d'un roman de Charles Dickens intitulé 'Les Grandes Espérances'. Pip est un jeune forgeron et va devoir trouver une solution pour conquérir le cœur de la belle Estella.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman adhère à la Nambla
programme.desc: Cartman en a marre des autres. Pour lui ils ne sont pas assez matures. Il décide de trouver des amis adultes sur Internet, mais tous ses amis se font envoyer en prison. Il va voir Mephesto pour avoir un ami artificiel.

programme.title: South Park: Tampons en Cheveux de Cherok
programme.desc: Kyle tombe gravement malade, et en ville tout le monde ne jure que par la médecine à base de plantes des indiens. La mère de Kyle refuse alors de faire hospitaliser son fils croyant qu'il ira mieux avec les plantes.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Pète les Plombs
programme.desc: Chef est scandalisé : le drapeau de South Park est selon lui raciste. Afin d'en juger avec la plus grande impartialité, il est demandé aux enfants de décider s'il faut changer ou non le drapeau.

programme.title: South Park: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt
programme.desc: Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.
programme.sub-title: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt

programme.title: South Park: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer?
programme.desc: Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Probablement
programme.desc: Dans l'épisode précédent, les garçons découvrent le Pasteur en plein acte sexuel dans son église. Cartman décide de prendre les choses en main afin de remettre dans le droit chemin tous les enfants de la ville.

programme.title: South Park: CM1
programme.desc: C'est la rentrée. Les garçons arrivent en CM1, heureux de ne plus se faire taper par les grands du CM1. Mais ce sont désormais les CM2 qui les tapent. La nouvelle prof Mme Chrokelpaf, ainsi que la nouvelle façon de travailler les effrayent.

programme.title: South Park: Le Super Classeur
programme.desc: Cartman vient d'acheter un tout nouveau classeur avec toutes les fonctionnalités. C'est alors qu'un homme venu du futur le prévient que ce classeur peut envahir la planète. Le classeur est donc détruit, mais Cartman s'en rachète un le lendemain.

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! The Musical
programme.desc: Thanksgiving approche et comme tous les ans, les CM1 doivent jouer la vie d'Helene Keller. Butters s'est infiltré chez les maternelles et leur annonce que leur spectacle est superbe.

programme.title: South Park: Camp de Régime
programme.desc: Cartman est envoyé en Camp de Régime car tous ses proches trouvent que c'est mauvais pour lui d'être gros. Il décide alors de tirer profit de cette expérience, mais pas de la manière dont ses proches le souhaiteraient.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mot en M
programme.desc: Les enfants veulent aller voir un concert, mais les parents de Kyle refusent de le laisser y aller. Kyle décide alors de trouver un moyen pour se débarrasser d'eux. Cartman lui conseille d'appeler la police et de dire qu'il se fait maltraiter.

programme.title: South Park: Le Cycle du Caca
programme.desc: Cette année, les garçons ont peur de ne pas avoir de cadeaux de Noël. Les gens n'achètent plus. Kyle décide alors d'aller voir Mr Hankey pour l'aider a redonner l'esprit de Noël.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman doit mourir
programme.desc: Cartman voudrait être le premier de la bande à atteindre la puberté. Il achète donc des 'poils' 10 dollars à un garçon plus âgé, Scott Tenorman.

programme.title: South Park: Y'en a Dans Le Ventilo
programme.desc: La série Cop Drama va diffuser un épisode ou le mot 'Merde' sera prononcé. Dès lors une épidémie de peste se déclare.

programme.title: South Park: Combat d'Infirme
programme.desc: Al Super Gay est viré des scouts parce qu'il est gay. Et les enfants font la connaissance de Jimmy Valmer, un handicapé qui prend la vie avec humour. Mais Timmy est jaloux du succès de Jimmy, et un combat d'infirmes est engagé.

programme.title: South Park: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages
programme.desc: Terrence et Phillip, les canadiens pétomanes, mettent fin à leur duo pour divergences créatives. Les garçons se mettent en tête de réunir leurs idoles.
programme.sub-title: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages

programme.title: South Park: Cartman Land
programme.desc: Suite à la mort de sa grand-mère, Cartman hérite d'un million de dollars et réalise son rêve de toujours: il achète un parc d'attraction (dont il profite tout seul) qu'il rebaptise 'Cartmanland '.

programme.title: South Park: Du bon usage du preservatif
programme.desc: Les parents découvrent que leurs enfants sont très mal informés sur les choses du sexe. On demande à l'école de donner des cours. À croire que les parents ignorent qui sont les enseignants, Mme Crockelpaf, Mr Mackey et Mr Garrison.

programme.title: South Park: Servietsky
programme.desc: À peine les enfants ont-ils obtenu leur console Gamesphère qu'on leur enlève. Ils doivent livrer une serviette intelligente fumant des pétards a une organisation militaire. Seulement les gamins se retrouvent embrouillés dans une histoire.

programme.title: South Park: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul
programme.desc: Kenny, Cartman, Stan et Kyle sont envoyés par erreur en Afghanistan. Sur place et contre toute attente, ils vont s'apercevoir qu'ils ont beaucoup de points communs avec les enfants Afghans.
programme.sub-title: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul

programme.title: South Park: Comment manger avec son cul
programme.desc: Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park: L'Engin
programme.desc: Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les riches debarquent
programme.desc: Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Se Meurt
programme.desc: Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park: L'Episode de Butters
programme.desc: Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a Warlord lookalike.
programme.sub-title: OVERWHELMING! THE NAVY'S FIGHTING WEAPONS, THE PACIFISTAS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far deadlier foe comes looking for a fight.
programme.sub-title: AN EVEN STRONGER ENEMY APPEARS! THE BATTLE AXE-CARRYING SENTOMARU

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
programme.sub-title: ADMIRAL KIZARU'S FIERCE ASSAULT / THE STRAW HATS FACE CERTAIN DEATH!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
programme.sub-title: ELIMINATED FRIENDS - THE FINAL DAY OF THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a Warlord of the Sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / BOSS LUFFY APPEARS AGAIN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
programme.sub-title: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / DEFEAT THRILLER COMPANY'S TRAP!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man's amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
programme.sub-title: LANDING! THE ALL-FEMALE ISLAND, AMAZON LILY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy's family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
programme.sub-title: HURRY BACK TO YOUR FRIENDS! THE MAIDEN ISLAND ADVENTURE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she's about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
programme.sub-title: EVERYONE FALLS IN LOVE! PIRATE EMPRESS HANCOCK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a "drop-in" on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET HIDDEN ON THE BACKS / LUFFY AND THE SNAKE PRINCESS MEET

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Boa Hancock makes Luffy mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging the captain of the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: HEARTLESS JUDGMENT! MARGARET IS TURNED TO STONE!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Snake Princess pits Luffy's Gum-Gum abilities against the incredible Haki power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
programme.sub-title: A DIFFICULT FIGHT FOR LUFFY! THE SNAKE SISTERS' HAKI POWER!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy kicks his attack mode into Second Gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle's climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
programme.sub-title: ALL-OUT SPECIAL POWER BATTLE!! GUM-GUM VS. SNAKE-SNAKE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: News of Luffy's run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
programme.sub-title: HANCOCK'S CONFESSION-- THE SISTERS' ABHORRENT PAST

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty Kuja women eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him a safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
programme.sub-title: SAVING ACE! THE NEXT STOP: THE GREAT PRISON

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Boa Hancock's illness threatens to sabotage Luffy's rescue mission. However, the Snake Princess just can't say "no" to the rubber-man, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
programme.sub-title: LOVE IS A HURRICANE! LOVE-LOVE HANCOCK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! THE SCIENCE OF WEATHER AND THE MECHANICAL ISLAND

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji's refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of girlish hearts.
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! AN ISLAND OF GIANT BIRDS AND A PINK PARADISE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! BRIDGING THE ISLANDS AND VICIOUS VEGETATION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
programme.sub-title: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! A NEGATIVE PRINCESS AND THE KING OF DEMONS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace's execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
programme.sub-title: A DEADLY INFILTRATION! THE UNDERWATER PRISON IMPEL DOWN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who's going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There's no love lost between the former foes, but they'd better work together if they want to survive.
programme.sub-title: A REUNION IN HELL?! THE MAN WHO ATE THE CHOP-CHOP FRUIT!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down's Crimson Hell!
programme.sub-title: BREAK THROUGH THE CRIMSON HELL! BUGGY'S CHAOS-INDUCING PLAN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren't careful in Impel Down's Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubber-man might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison's putrid warden!
programme.sub-title: THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE PRISON! POISON MAN MAGELLAN APPEARS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
programme.sub-title: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / A GOLD LION'S AMBITION ON THE MOVE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The citizens of Little East Blue throw in a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the Beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
programme.sub-title: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / LITTLE EAST BLUE IN DANGER

programme.desc: A weekend's camping trip to the valley below the dam goes wrong when a violent storm moves in. With Red Alert trapped in a mudslide, the sluice gates about to open, and local reporter Kelly filming, how will the Autobots escape detection?

programme.desc: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player. The Decepticons acquire the final minicon to create the Skyboom Shield, the most powerful defensive weapon in the universe.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Confident of his ability to finally overcome the Autobots, Megatron challenges Optimus to battle. However, when all seems lost Optimus' minicon summons the Skyboom Shield to protect his master.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron's plan to split up the Autobot team and defeat them individually fails when it's revealed that the minicons have their own, secret agenda.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Decepticons lose another battle: Megatron takes out his frustration on Starscream, beating him half to death for no reason. Sideways uses the situation to try to foment unrest and rebellion.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Trapped in cyberspace with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity, far more powerful and dangerous than Megatron, lurking threateningly in the background. Or was it all a dream?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new transformer enters the solar system. On the moon, Thrust the master tactician arrives to assist Megatron in his battle against the Autobots, but all does not go according to plan.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command - and seriously underestimates the Decepticons. But on the verge of defeat, Optimus reveals a new ability.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron. On earth, despite Jetfire saying he's one of the good guys, the kids are suspicious of Sideways - as are the Decepticons. And something huge and ominous is approaching earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The massive Tidalwave joins the Decepticons, but is, seemingly, defeated in battle by Hot Shot and Blurr. Alexis discovers three new minicons, which Sideways says combine to create another ultimate weapon, the Requiem Blaster.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The kids try to gather the three Requiem Blaster minicons together. Sky Blast at first resists, then sings the others to him to save Optimus. They all realise there's more to the minicons than first appears.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Understanding that the minicons want to be in charge of their own destinies, the kids sneak the new team out of the base. Thrust finds them, but so do the Autobots who save the day. It's agreed the minicons should not be forced to fight.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Enthusiastic young Sideswipe, Blurr's hero-worshipper, joins the team and Optimus tasks Hot Shot with training him. Wheeljack also arrives on earth, bent on revenge for Hot Shot seemingly abandoning him during a battle on Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough. Wheeljack takes Sideswipe hostage, but Hot Shot rescues him. On the moon, Megatron welcomes Wheeljack to the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron sacrifices Starscream, leaving him to face the Autobots alone while the Decepticons infiltrate the Autobot base to capture the Requiem Blaster. Smokescreen sacrifices himself to try to protect the Blaster minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hearing Megatron say he is nothing more than disposable cannon fodder, Starscream defects with the Star Sabre. To prove he's genuine, he gives the Autobots details of the moon base. Red Alert works on what's left of Smokescreen.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Starscream's help, the Autobots infiltrate the Decepticon moon base, attempting to rescue all the minicons Megatron has captured and forced into building a spaceship.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the kids befriending and welcoming him, the Autobots deeply suspicious of him, and driven by his need to kill Megatron, the deeply conflicted Starscream trusts Thrust and returns to the moon base with the Star Sabre and Skyboom Shield.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Sabre, Shield and Blaster together create the Hydra Cannon. Installed on their new ship, the Decepticons test it on a comet - then Megatron orders Starscream to use it to destroy the Autobot base. Problem is, that'll also destroy the earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Optimus and Jetfire attack the ship, but can't stop the Hydra Cannon being deployed. Optimus makes the ultimate sacrifice and takes the full blast. Afterwards only his minicon and his matrix are found, but at least earth survives.

programme.desc: With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot, supported by the rest of the team, refuse to let the children accompany them. But then the minicons refuse to allow the ship to depart unless the kids are on board.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The 'Bots reach Cybertron to find Megatron (now calling himself Galvatron) already winning the war. The minicons fend off an attack by Unicron, warning of great danger, but Galvatron believes it just an Autobot trick.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: While the battle continues, Hot Shot goes to Cybertron to try to convince Galvatron of the impending danger. Thrust's true allegiance and agenda is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada

programme.title: Transformers: Armada

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: To convince Galvatron he must ally with Optimus to prevent Unicron taking over the universe, Starscream makes the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The only way to defeat Unicron is to wake the minicons inside him and attack from within as well as without. Red Alert and the kids use the portal to travel to Unicron's core.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A new girl has arrived in town and no one knows anything about her. And judging by the strange things happening at her house no one wants to know. Then, it's great having a friend spend the weekend.
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Moves In/The Perfect Brother

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. saves everything. But her most prized possession is a snowball from last winter. But now it’s disappeared! Then, Arthur, Francine, and Buster must do a report on ancient Rome--but can they work as a team to complete the assignment?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mr. Ratburn's class is taking a field trips to visit parents at their jobs. Francine's not sure she wants the class to know her dad is a garbage man. And a new carpet and a sneezing attack means Muffy must spend the weekend at Francine's.
programme.sub-title: My Dad, The Garbage Man/Poor Muffy

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. has one little secret--her blankie. When it mysteriously disappears, Arthur is pressed into service. Find that blankie--or else! Next, the unbelievable has happened--Mr. Ratburn has gotten sick. And who's going to be the substitute?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Challenged by Fern to enter a poetry contest, Arthur and his friends each write a poem to be judged by the famous poet Jack Prelutsky. Then, Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The gang can't agree on rules for their club, and each starts his own. Next, Francine's embarrassed by her crummy old bike. Why can't she have a shiny new one like all her friends?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Have you ever been afraid of the dark? Despite D.W.'s threat of aliens, Arthur sets his tent for his first sleepover. Then, what exactly happens at midnight, December 31st? There are plenty of rumors, but no one seems to know for sure.
programme.sub-title: Arthur's First Sleepover/Arthur's New Year's Eve

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Mister Rogers is staying at Arthur's house! Mister Rogers is a nice guy, but... his show is for babies! Can Arthur hide the visit from his friends? Next, the trouble starts when Fern draws a not-too-flattering cartoon of Francine.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's a nightmare--Arthur and Buster have to work with Binky. On an art project! I mean, what does a bully like Binky know about art? Then, Arthur discovers the secret to success--a pencil that brings good luck to whoever possesses it.
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Art Expert/Arthur's Lucky Pencil

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's wrong to call D.W. a picky eater. The only things she won't eat are vegetables, fish, fruit, and meat. Then, Arthur and Buster meet two really cool kids and, naturally, are utterly dazzled. How far will Buster go to be cool?
programme.sub-title: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Too young to see a real "James Hound" movie, the kids decide they'll make a film of their own. Next, how would YOU like to be four years old and completely misunderstood by your parents? And then be sent to your room for ten whole minutes?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go To Your Room!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur thinks it's hilarious when Binky Barnes' pants split during class--until he starts having nightmares about it happening to him. Then, Francine secretly dreams of being an Olympic equestrienne, but first she has to learn to ride.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A cat gets stuck in a tree and Buster Baxter saves the day! Risking life and limb! Next, the ridiculous Crazy Bus song is EVERYWHERE, but mostly it's in the Read's home, because D.W. has to play it 4000 times a day.
programme.sub-title: Buster Baxter, Cat Saver/Play It Again, D.W.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The kids and parents of Ellwood City have all pledged not to watch TV for one whole week. Can they last? Then, big, brave Binky Barnes would be toast if people ever discovered he can't sleep without a night light.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur gets stage fright during a rehearsal. Will he be able to get through his recital without any mistakes? Then, two opinionated friends butt heads! Can Francine and The Brain put aside their differences for the good of the soccer team?
programme.sub-title: Arthur vs. The Piano/The Big Blow-Up

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: One day, Arthur falls asleep on a bus and awakens in a strange part of town. Will he ever find his way home? Can he keep himself from crying? Next, summer vacation is over? What about all those great, fun things Arthur intended to do?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W.'s on her way to Washington and she's bored by it all until she gets lost during a tour of the White House. Then, when Mr. Haney gives Arthur a sealed envelope to bring home to Mom, Arthur fears the worst.
programme.sub-title: D.W. Goes To Washington/Arthur's Mystery Envelope

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!
programme.sub-title: D.W.'s Deer Friend/Buster Hits the Books

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's in the midst of writing a great adventure story with Buster when he gets some very bad news--Buster is leaving town to go live with his Dad for a while. Then, does Francine have a crush on Arthur?
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Faraway Friend/Arthur and The Square Dance

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Is The Brain a snob? That seems to be the explanation for why he won't go to Waterworld with his friends. And, Arthur's a notorious joke-killer. But when he's scheduled to perform as a carnival clown, he learns how to make people laugh!
programme.sub-title: Water and The Brain/Arthur The Unfunny

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Poor Sue Ellen has lost the one thing she's never without--her diary. Then, Arthur's hurt his knee but won't tell Mom--because then she'd know he'd been playing down at the dump , where he was NOT allowed to go.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.
programme.sub-title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy tries to bribe the judges at the school science fair, Francine and The Brain plot revenge. And D.W., a newly-deputized Junior Safety Officer, has a reputation for being a strict enforcer of the rules--well, OK, a tattle-tale.
programme.sub-title: Love Notes For Muffy/D.W. Blows The Whistle

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Odd Squad/For Emergencies Only: Timmy wishes he had a talking car. Cosmo and Wanda are so busy with Poof they’re neglecting Timmy.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Cheese and Crockers/Land Before Timmy: Timmy wishes up a machine that allows him to merge with other items to become half-Timmy/half-whatever. Timmy’s tired of technology taking over and ruining his life so he wishes for a simpler world.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Merry Wishmas!: When Timmy doesn’t get what he wants for Christmas he simply wishes for it. But his friends can’t do the same, so Timmy wishes every kid could get a magical coupon that would allow them to wish for the one thing they didn't get.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity: Shya! Mark Chang is called back to Yugopotamia to become king while his father, under attack from a mystery assailant, flees for his life. Dark Laser’s back and tries to make Timmy his apprentice!
programme.sub-title: King Chang/The End of the Universe-ity

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Sooper Poof: Poof is trying to get the hang of shape shifting – unfortunately he takes after Cosmo! Timmy’s been running Cosmo and Wanda ragged so Jorgen takes him to "Wishing Well."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Wishy Washy/Poof's Play Date: Dad entrusts Timmy with washing and preserving his classic Stryker Z sports car! Wanda worries that Poof doesn’t have interaction with other fairy babies, so Timmy turns the adult fairies into babies, so Poof can play with.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Vicky Gets Fired/CHINdred Spirits: Vicky is determined to get a job after Timmy's parents fire her. Timmy wishes up a girlfriend for Crimson Chin and soon the Chin dating a woman named Golden Locks…except now the comic is both boring and romantic.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: 9 Lives/Dread 'n' Breakfast: When Catman tells Timmy that he’s used up 8 of his 9 cat lives saving Dimmsdale from crime, Timmy helps Catman find a "safer" job where he can still help people. Mom turns the house into a bed and breakfast!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Birthday bashed/Momnipresent: Timmy is excited for his birthday until he realizes that one year older means one year closer to losing his fairies. He spends the entire day trying to thwart all party plans, leading his Mom and Dad to think he's gone crazy!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy goes on an adventure to search for his fairies and a magical wand that will defeat the Darkness.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy learns he merely slowed down The Darkness and now he must seek a second wand to defeat this evil force. Timmy is forced to make amends with his enemies in order to fight for mankind.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Confident and secure, Timmy feels great having won the battle against The Darkness. His world is quickly turned upside down as he learns that he didn’t win, but is now living inside The Darkness!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Anti-Poof: For every fairy, there’s an anti-fairy – thus anti-Poof is born – FOOP! It’s up to Poof to stop this anti-fairy from destroying Fairy World and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Add-A-Dad/Squirrely Puffs: Dad is too busy to spend quality time with Timmy, so he wishes up "a-lot-a-dads" to hang out with. It's a race between the Squirrely Scouts and the Cream Puffs to the top of Mount Doom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Mice-Capades/Formula For Disaster: Poof has been watching too much of a classic, yet violent "cat & mouse" cartoon. He innocently turns Timmy and Vicky into "Cheesy and Sleazy" and all mayhem breaks loose.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Bad Heir Day/Freaks and Greeks: Crocker wants an heir to his supposed "fortune and fame." Poof coincidentally ends up in his care and Crocker is set for life.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Fly Boy/Temporary Fairy: Everybody in Dimmsdale is watching the latest horror film, "Fly Boy." But Timmy isn't allowed to, so when he wishes to become a "fly on the wall".

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Crocker Shocker/Super Zero: Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies and becomes normal again. Unfortunately, Fairy World can no longer feed off his spastic energy, and all their magic shuts down.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dadbracadbra/Timmy Turnip: With a little help from Timmy, Dad’s magic tricks really work. Convinced that Timmy’s dad is a fairy, Crocker is out to prove it and uncover his secret on national television.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: One Man Banned/Frenemy Mine: After Timmy’s rejected from the school band, he wishes everyone would love his music./Timmy saves Vicky from a horrible accident and suddenly she is stricken by his generosity.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Chicken Poofs/Stupid Cupid: Poof gets the "Chicken Poofs" and turns everyone into actual chickens! Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him and go to the school "Romance Dance."

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Double Oh Schnozmo/Planet Poof: Cosmo’s brother, the top secret spy, pays a visit. But when Schnozmo’s revealed to be nothing but a con man, Wanda demands that Schnozmo participate in a real spy adventure in order to spare Cosmo’s feelings.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: It's "Bring Your Kid to Work Day," and Dad takes Timmy to his office. When Timmy accidentally eats Poof (who is hiding as a marshmallow in Timmy's cereal) Timmy becomes magically talented at soccer.
programme.sub-title: The Boss of Me/He Poofs, He Scores!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Play Date... of Doom/Teacher's Pet: Foop is back! He’s escaped from prison and convinced Cosmo and Wanda he’s ready for a playdate with Poof. But he’s really there to try and destroy his arch enemy again, and it’s up to Timmy and Poof to thwart his plan.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Timmy gripes that being Mom is easier than being a kid, Wanda takes the bait and switches their brains. Now Mom is Timmy, and Timmy is Mom!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad mistake Cosmo for a ghost and restart their failed ghost-hunting business, Timmy wishes that the fairies would pretend to haunt Dimmsdale.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: After failing miserably on a game show for 6th graders, Dad admits he dropped out of school in the 5th grade. The next thing Timmy knows, Dad’s in his class!
programme.sub-title: Old Man and the C-/Balance of Flour

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners: Tired of Mom’s terrible dinners, Timmy wishes Mom were the best chef in the world.
programme.sub-title: Food Fight/Please Don't Feed the Turners

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Timmy borrows Mark Chang’s Fake-i-fier in order to attend Trixie’s costume party. Unfortunately, he knows nothing about Yugopotamian technology and soon the device is causing Timmy to turn into all sorts of crazy creatures.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: An exhausted Timmy makes a wish for complete darkness so he can get some sleep. But he doesn’t count on Cosmo and Wanda turning into Scary Fairies in the dark.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dad decides to convert the Turner home into a farm. Unfortunately, it takes Cosmo and Wanda’s magic to give Dad a green thumb, and when they’re swept away by a tornado, it’s up to Timmy to save the farm...and his fairies!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Dad changes Timmy’s room into a surveillance center to prove that his kindly neighbor, Dinkleberg, is truly evil. Being the best neighbor ever, Dinkleberg pretends to be evil just to make Dad feel better.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Poof and Foop compete to win the affections of Goldie Goldenglow, a magical new girl at Spellementary School (who’s shaped like a triangle) while participating in the Spellementary School play, "Mr. Cookie’s Happy Day."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tom and Karen say Madison, 15, is out of control. Tom has served seven tours of duty in the Middle East commanding troops but says he's faced his scariest and most dangerous enemy in his own home. Fearing for their lives, they need Dr. Phil’s help. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Calah Waskow, 15, made national news when allegedly abducted by her friend's 37-year-old dad. Issuing an Amber Alert, Calah was found five days later. What happened to her? Did she have a secret relationship with the older man? Calah tells her story.
programme.sub-title: 15-Year-Old Runs Away With Her Friend's Dad: The Amber Alert, The Search And The Rescue

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After former friends Randi & Haley tell Brittany's history of harassing men & faking pregnancies, Dr. Phil talks to Brittany and asks her to prove she is pregnant. What sent Brittany storming off stage? See the backstage conversation with Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: Brittany Speaks Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection & sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? What Did Grandma Know? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Is Delusional And Lying About Being 9 Months Pregnant Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Haley adamantly claims she’s pregnant and about to give birth to Jesus, the Son of God. Dr. Travis Stork reveals the result of Haley’s ultrasound. Is she pregnant and giving birth in two weeks? How will Haley handle the truth if she isn’t pregnant? Part 2
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Believes She's Pregnant With Jesus: What Will The Ultrasound Show Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keith says his wife of 18 years, Sarah, is divorcing him and leaving their four children for "Kevin," a 26-year-old Kenyan pastor she met only on the internet. Dr. Phil sent a team to Kenya to investigate. You won’t want to miss what they discover!
programme.sub-title: My Wife Of 18 Years And Mother Of Our 4 Children Is Divorcing Me For A 26-Year-Old Kenyan Man She's Never Met

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Courtney claims her former friend Amie has lied about being pregnant three times and losing five babies total. To uncover the truth, Dr. Phil producers spoke with the county coroner, the hospital, and tracked down one of the supposed fathers-to-be. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accused Of Faking Multiple Pregnancies And Baby Deaths: Is She Scamming Men Or A Victim Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mark & ex-wife, Melissa, say daughter, Malia, 17, has been running away since age 13, a 6th grade school drop out, & has become physically abusive. They say 2 years ago she became involved with a 35-year-old man & they fear she'll end up dead.
programme.sub-title: Our Runaway Teen Daughter Thinks She's In Love With An Older Man Who Police Allege Raped And Threatened Her

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stacey & Dan say daughter Tylor, 18, is a rageaholic who is verbally, mentally & physically abusive. They have called the police 30 times, have had Tylor arrested 10 times & now Tylor is 7 weeks pregnant! Can this family join forces for the unborn child?
programme.sub-title: Our Pregnant, Rageaholic, 18-Year-Old Daughter Is Abusing Our Entire Family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Divorced parents Christina and Jim along with daughter Tara, 21, discuss that dad's new wife is the same age as Tara, how it's ok Tara is a webcam model to help pay bills, and that all this is making Tara a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.
programme.sub-title: My Narcissistic Ex Allows My Daughter To Work As A Webcam Model And Married A Girl The Same Age Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pamela says she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations. Pamela says Justin attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Justin says they are lies!
programme.sub-title: Help! My Narcissist Ex Is Abusing My Children And Nobody Believes Me

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shaela went from being a mom to two with a master's degree working as a school counselor to being unemployed & living in an RV. Mom Sandra says Shaela has exhibited strange behaviors, including trimming bushes & pulling weeds in the middle of the night.
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Inside the “California House of Horrors” where 13 children were starved, chained and abused by their own parents. Family, neighbors and childhood friends speak about the tragedy. Cleveland kidnap survivor Michelle Knight sends a message to the children.
programme.sub-title: Inside The California House Of Horror: 13 Children Rescued After Being Shackled And Abused

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Crystal accuses her ex-boyfriend, Anthony, of sexually assaulting their 3-year-old daughter. Crystal says she has proof confirming Anthony as the monster she says he is. Anthony says Crystal is “crazy and a liar.” Can Dr. Phil expose the truth? Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Lies, Child Sex Abuse, And Stalking Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Christina, Jim & daughter Tara. She says she's worried her daughter is in a toxic situation with dad Jim & his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Meet the new wife & find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.
programme.sub-title: Ex-Wife, New Wife, And Daughter Caught In The Middle Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues discussion with exes Michael and Susan, as well as Susan’s new husband, Cory, about the care of 11-year-old Bodhi, who Susan insists is experiencing schizophrenia, just like Michael and Susan’s 16-year-old daughter, Janni. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Second Schizophrenic Child Or A Misdiagnosing Mom: Can Bodhi Be Helped Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikki & Paige say mom Leigh is an alcoholic who has "gone missing" at least 40 times, abandoned them as teens in a foreclosed home without electricity or running water & is drunk around her grandchildren. Will Leigh listen and take Dr. Phil's help?
programme.sub-title: M.I.A., Drunk And In Denial: Worst Grandmother Of The Year?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa says Destoni, 14, is an aggressive, violent bully. She's chased her sister with a butcher knife, yells at teachers in the hallways but Destoni crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students, causing suspension. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Expelled, Handcuffed & Violent: My 14-Year-Old Daughter Is Out Of Control Pt. 1

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The two funniest and most brilliant chef/restaurateurs in Canada, Joe Beef's Dave McMillan and Fred Morin, take Tony across Canada by rail.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony and his friend, world-renowned chef Eric Ripert, explore the far reaches of indigenous Andes in search of a rare variety of wild cocoa that is said to be the "best" in the world.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: For the first time, Tony visits Budapest, 25 years after democracy planted its flag –alongside the Oscar-winning master of light, cinematographer Vilmos Zsigmond, as one of his key guides.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode, we leave behind Africa we’ve come to know in the news. Instead, we embrace the wild, untamed land of mystery, adventure, and exoticism; Zanzibar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The first time Tony visited Beirut, it didn't end well. Now Tony is back in Beirut, where all the world’s troubles and all the world's good comes together to form a city like no other.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The Bronx is burning, became the defining image of New York City in the 70s. Politicians used it as a backdrop illustrate the dire situation in America’s cities while local officials let it burn

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode Tony travels to the lesser-known, North Eastern Coast of Jamaica. White sandy beaches and a cool breeze with a tropical umbrella drink in hand is usually the perception of island life.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are three locations Tony has never travelled to before.The intense and fraught relationship between these places is hard to understand but Tony will attempt to delve into the lives of those who live here, through their food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Libyan hip-hop, Italian restaurants, tribal allegiances and post-war uncertainty in Libya. Bourdain looks at the country through personal stories, food, and the music of anti-Qaddafi rapper expats.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores the other Hawaii, the one that those eight million tourists don’t see when they come to the islands. He discovers the fabric of a true cultural mixing pot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Roy Choi’s food reflects a new American idea of "natural" fusion. Bourdain examines the meeting point of Asian, Mexican, Latino culture in modern LA.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.
